description: This file contains the implementation of the Blog class which extends the Controller class in the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for managing blog modules. It includes methods for displaying the blog module's configuration page and saving its settings, with detailed handling of input validation, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the blog module in the OpenCart admin extension, handling display and save actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the blog module, setting up breadcrumbs, permissions, and retrieving existing module data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the blog module settings, including permission checks, validation, and updating or adding module entries.
